clusters.title: Ros Chown obituary
clusters.neutral_headline: Ros Chown obituary

items.title: Ros Chown obituary
items.standfirst: My wife, Ros Chown, who has died aged 71, spent most of her working career as a sexual health adviser (SHA) in genito-urinary medicine in Cambridge, Wakefield and Torbay. She was an active member of the Society of Health Advisors in Sexual Transmitted Diseases and contributed to the Department of Health’s Handbook for Sexual Health Advisers (2004).Ros was a strong advocate of the public health role of SHAs in reducing sexually transmitted infections through advice on safe sex and contraception, partner notification, health promotion and counselling. In the early 1990s she was at the forefront of advising patients about new antiviral measures for the treatment of HIV that were being introduced. Continue reading...

items.title: Pennsylvania asks CDC for emergency help as measles outbreak spreads
items.standfirst: State reportedly asks for emergency assistance as state Democratic governor spars with US health secretaryPennsylvania is seeking emergency assistance from the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) as a major measles outbreak spreads across the state. The state warned the request could be withdrawn unless the federal agency publicly recognizes four measles-associated deaths reported by the state.The Pennsylvania department of health has begun the process of requesting CDC emergency support known as an Epi-Aid, according to a letter reviewed by the Guardian. The letter was first reported by Reuters on Thursday. Continue reading...
